international.title: ‘Really making history’: five takeaways from the meeting between Trump, Xi and Putin
international.summary: Leaders focused on nuclear weapons and international courts at their unprecedented gathering in Shenzhen Apec summit live – latest updates The presidents of the US, China and Russia met on Thursday for an unprecedented trilateral gathering on the sidelines of the Apec summit in Shenzhen. The session lasted more than an hour and Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin touched on nuclear weapons, the war in Ukraine and wider international security. The trio lead the world’s three major nuclear powers and their decisions have far-reaching consequences for global security.
